limitations: Metadata tokens are build-local coordinates and are only meaningful with the reported artifact SHA-256 and MVID.
CIL instruction anchors are decoded from file-backed method bodies only; no target assembly is loaded or executed.
Signatures are decoded for common ECMA-335 primitive, class, valuetype, pointer, byref, array, and generic variable forms; unsupported forms retain raw signature hashes.
Calls are static references; they do not establish execution order or branch reachability.
Nested type names can be ambiguous; preserve declaring type tokens with method tokens.
Local budget override is an analyzer modification, not an upstream REA release.
